async def async_get_config_entry_diagnostics(
    hass: HomeAssistant, entry: DucoConfigEntry
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Return diagnostics for a config entry."""
    coordinator = entry.runtime_data
    client = coordinator.client

    lan_info = await client.async_get_lan_info()
    diagnostics = await client.async_get_diagnostics()
    write_requests_remaining = await client.async_get_write_req_remaining()

            "duco_diagnostics": [
                {"component": component.component, "status": str(component.status)}
                for component in diagnostics
            ],
            "write_requests_remaining": write_requests_remaining,
        },
        TO_REDACT,
    )
